scope: New SVG lanes only. All cross-lane structural pairs; visual scale/orientation screening specifically for the 82 newly accepted vector originals against all other new SVG lanes. Existing-catalog overlap is outside this additional review.

methods.structural: scripts.duplicate_audit_svg._parse and _geometry_pair. Exact drawable family strips paint/style/timing; candidate skeleton additionally removes non-geometry attributes and animations. Static transforms, root dimensions/viewBox, local references and defs/mask/pattern context are preserved. Geometry deltas max <=1.5% and RMS <=0.6% of smaller viewBox extent.
methods.visual: Inert original image/svg+xml at 128px, every network request blocked, no source JavaScript executed. Bounding-box-normalized 32px silhouettes and gray content, all quarter rotations and horizontal reflections. Candidate IoU>=0.93, alphaMAE<=7, and grayMAE<=9 or dHash256 distance<=12. Color/viewport-size/orientation screening is not proof of exact geometry.
limits: XML command representation and transform-chain equivalence are not algebraically flattened.
Raster screening is finite resolution and may miss or overestimate visually similar constructions.
Pattern repetitions, motif tiles and material surfaces are not automatically merged with a shape merely because a primitive or silhouette coincides.
Only actual candidate visual/composition review produces a verdict. Absence of candidates is not proof of global perceptual uniqueness.

The initial actual-source silhouette comparison included Game Icons opaque viewport backgrounds. The independent additional backgroundFreeInkScreen removes only the exact known source backdrop in an audit clone, retains original actual-preview pixels, and screens all 82 vectors against all 1,938 new shapes with root-provided geometry masks. Maximum closest-ink IoU was 0.88220816, below0.925.
methods.visualReview: Both all-lane nearest-context sheets and background-free nearest-shape sheets, six pages per view, were individually reviewed. Gray compositing makes transparent white wire patterns and black figure outlines legible. No identity or near-identity was found.
